chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I heard Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام saying: “When you descend into a grave, then say: In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, and upon the creed of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. Then lower the deceased gently. When you place him in his grave, loosen his knots and say: O Allah, O Lord, Your servant and the son of Your servant has come down to You, and You are the best one to whom one comes down. O Allah, if he was virtuous, then increase him in his virtue; and if he was sinful, then overlook him. Join him to his Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله and to the righteous of his Shi'ah, and guide us and him to a straight path. O Allah, Your pardon, Your pardon.”

Then place your left hand on his left shoulder and shake him firmly. Then say: O so-and-so son of so-and-so, when you are questioned, say: Allah is my Lord, Muhammad is my Prophet, Islam is my religion, the Qur'an is my book, and 'Ali is my Imam—until you complete the Imams. Then repeat the words to him, then say: Have you understood, O so-and-so?” He عليه السلام said: “For he will answer and say: Yes. Then you say: May Allah make you firm...

May Allah cause recognition between you and your awliya' in an abode of His mercy. Then say: O Allah, keep the earth away from his sides, raise his soul up to You, and grant him from Yourself a proof. O Allah, Your pardon, Your pardon. Then place the clay and the bricks, and so long as you place the clay and the bricks, say: O Allah, join his loneliness, give him intimacy in his desolation, grant him safety from his terror, and settle upon him from Your mercy a mercy by which You make him independent of the mercy of anyone besides You, for indeed Your mercy is for the wrongdoers.
“Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we return.”
Then you come out of the grave and say: O Allah, raise his rank in the highest 'Illiyyin, succeed him among those remaining behind, and with You we reckon him, O Lord of the worlds.”

key_terms.أَوْلِيَائِكَ: Your friends/allies; those with whom the deceased is asked to be reunited
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave into which the deceased is placed
key_terms.الْقُرْآنُ: the revealed Book affirmed by the deceased in talqin
key_terms.صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ: the straight path of divine guidance
key_terms.عَفْوَكَ: Your pardon; a repeated plea for divine forgiveness
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ إِمَامِي: 'Ali as my Imam, part of the burial talqin formula
key_terms.عِلِّيِّينَ: the highest exalted station for the righteous

ai.seo_question: What should be recited and done when burying a deceased person according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the supplications and actions to be performed when placing the deceased into the grave, including talqin and prayers for mercy, firmness, and guidance. It emphasizes the deceased’s affirmation of faith, prophethood, the Qur'an, and the Imamate, as well as seeking divine pardon and comfort for the dead in the grave.
